To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Poverty reduction is a challenge in the Seventh day Adventists church in Kenya and the church needs a strategy to address this problem.

1) poverty is a major challenge in the SDA Church in Kenya and is reflected in the tithe and offering records, 2) the SDA Church has a program that is designed to address poverty in its members, but this program is not being implemented in the churches, 3) the program for poverty reduction is not being implemented because the local churches are not aware of it, and 4) the local churches do not have the necessary skills to implement the poverty reduction programs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a strategy for poverty elimination among the Seventh day Adventists in Kenya.
